newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds fall unexpectedly after Buba comment.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds fall unexpectedly after Buba comment.

text.p: Danish bond prices fell to close unexpectedly lower on Wednesday on remarks by leading Bundesbank economist Otmar Issing discounting any imminent German rate cuts.
Dealers saw the outcome of the five-year U.S. state bond auction as determining Thursday's market trend, but the general mood was optimistic about trade during the days to come.
"I am not too pessimistic about tomorrow despite falls in the German December bund and the Danish 2006 benchmark sparked by Issing," one dealer said.
The market had been expected to close higher.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 closed 0.37 point down from the opening at 107.80.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany ended the day one basis point narrower at 84 basis points, while the crown closed at a weaker 3.8335 per mark.
